describe('Exported Contrast requirements', () => {
  for (const check of spec.checks) {
    if (!check.executable) { test.todo(check.id + ': missing executable observation/adapter integration'); continue; }
    test(check.id + ': ' + check.left + ' ' + check.kind + ' ' + check.right + ' on ' + check.channel, () => {
      const vector = (caseId: string) => check.observationIds.map(id => {
        const o = spec.project.observations.find(item => item.id === id)!;
        const c = spec.project.cases.find(item => item.id === caseId)!;
        const value = normalize(o, observe(o.adapter!, c.input ?? '', o.operation!));
        expect(value).not.toBeNull();
        return value;
      });
      const left = vector(check.left), right = vector(check.right);
      if (check.kind === 'same') expect(left).toEqual(right);
      else expect(left).not.toEqual(right);
    });
  }
});
